topic: 时序信用分配：资格痕迹与突触标签捕获

sources.title: Synaptic tagging and long-term potentiation
sources.relevance: STC假说的原始发现——弱刺激在有强刺激协同时可被升级为L-LTP
sources.key_finding: 标签有效期约3h，蛋白合成依赖，同细胞不同输入间的协同LTP

sources.title: Making memories last: the synaptic tagging and capture hypothesis
sources.relevance: STC假说的系统综述——区分功能性和结构性可塑性机制
sources.key_finding: 诱导突触增强只创造持久改变的潜力，不等于实现承诺

sources.title: Relevance of synaptic tagging and capture to the persistence of long-term potentiation and everyday spatial memory
sources.authors: Wang SH, Redondo RL, Morris RG
sources.relevance: 行为标记假说的直接实验证明——新颖环境通过D1/D5受体和蛋白合成将STM升级为LTM
sources.key_finding: 16只大鼠中14只在新颖事件后24h显示记忆保留（t₁₅=4.35，P<0.001）；D1/D5拮抗剂和蛋白合成抑制剂均可阻断

sources.title: Postsynaptic burst reactivation of hippocampal neurons enables associative plasticity of temporally discontiguous inputs
sources.authors: Fuchsberger T, Clopath C, Jarzebowski P, Brzosko Z, Wang H, Paulsen O
sources.relevance: 资格痕迹的直接实验证明——NMDA-AC1/AC8沉默踪迹可等待10分钟后的DA+爆发触发LTP
sources.key_finding: 初始post-before-pre→LTD（61±11%）；10min后DA+爆发→LTP（135±14.9%）；AC1/AC8双敲除消除效应；NMDA-R已关闭时仍有效

sources.title: Synapses tagged, memories kept: synaptic tagging and capture hypothesis in brain health and disease
sources.authors: Bin Ibrahim MZ, Wang Z, Sajikumar S
sources.journal: Philos Trans R Soc Lond B Biol Sci
sources.relevance: STC在老化、AD、睡眠剥夺和癌症相关认知损害中失效的综合综述
sources.key_finding: STC比晚期LTP更敏感地反映突触健康；DA通过D1/D5→ERK1/2调制STC；标签候选：CP-AMPARs, CaMKII, TrkB多分子复合体

sources.title: Dichotomous dopaminergic control of striatal synaptic plasticity
sources.authors: Shen W, Flajolet M, Greengard P, Surmeier DJ
sources.relevance: 背景参考：D1/D2不对称纹状体STDP规则（来自文章#158）

sources.title: What does LTP tell us about the roles of CaMKII and PKMζ in memory?
sources.relevance: CaMKII（诱导）vs PKMζ（维持）LTP的功能分工，为理解PRPs在STC中的角色提供背景
sources.key_finding: CaMKII自主活性只持续几分钟（诱导）；PKMζ活性持续数小时到数月（维持）；PKMζ通过抑制GluA2-AMPAR内吞维持突触强度
